description: Call this FIRST before any other tool for this provider. Signs in with the workplace certificate and stores the session the other si4n tools reuse. Call it first; call it again if a tool reports the session expired.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

business_registration_no.description: 사업자등록번호 - 숫자 열 자리(하이픈 없이). 예: 1234567890.
